summary: Perpetuals.com Ltd, a Tokyo-based foreign private issuer listed on a U.S. exchange, furnished a Form 6-K on September 16, 2026, containing notice and proxy materials for an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders (the U.S. equivalent of a special meeting) to be held in Tokyo on October 6, 2026, with voting instructions due by 6:00 p.m. JST October 5, 2026. The agenda covers a charter amendment to transition from a statutory-auditor (kansayaku) structure to a company with a nominating committee, the election of eight directors and an accounting auditor, and two issuances of shares for subscription. The filing is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; watch for dilutive subscription terms, governance implications and any related-party identity behind the share issuances.
